# /etc/systemd/system/tg-shadow-scan.service
[Unit]
Description=Shadow signals scanner for timeframes without live watching (Regression account)
After=network-online.target
[Service]
User=tbot
Environment=POS_DIR=/opt/trading-bot/positions_regr
Environment=CHAN_SRC=regr
Environment=CHAN_EDGE=1
Environment=TG_GATE=1
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
WorkingDirectory=/opt/tg-notify
ExecStart=/opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python /opt/tg-notify/tg_shadow_scan.py
Restart=always
inactive
tg_shadow_scan.py
